text:
marie: heads up — product wants per-customer dashboards for the next pilot. we need runtime + infra signals to build a tenant view and a noisy-neighbor detector. can eng-runtime + observability sync on required metrics?

sam: +1. we can emit tenant_id on request traces and per-inference metrics. current fields: model, route, latency_ms, gpu_util, tokens_out. we should add tenant_id and queue_time_ms. cardinality is a concern though. :thinking_face:

li: quick note — exposing tenant_id into metrics increases label cardinality a LOT. we should plan cardinality-safe aggregates and sampled tags. also need RBAC so customers only see their org.

marie: agreed. product wants a per-org dashboard in console (self-serve) and also an internal noisy-neighbor alerting view. how about two layers: (1) coarse per-org aggregates for console (rpm, median latency, error_rate, spend_estimate) and (2) high-cardinality internal view for SRE/CS with sampling and on-demand drilldowns?

sam: that matches what we can emit. proposal: runtime emits low-cardinality metrics tagged with tenant_bucket (hashed bucket) for console, and emits detailed tenant_id logs to a secure clickhouse table for internal use. bucket count default 1000. examples: `tenant_bucket`, `per_org_token_rate`, `kv_cache_hit_rate`

nika: for UX, customers expect realtime-ish numbers and ability to filter by model + date range. can the console query the low-cardinality metrics endpoint? what's the latency?

marie: console will pull from telemetry API that reads pre-aggregated time-series (1m rollups). aim for <5s freshness for hosted plan, 30s for long-rollout plans. we should document limits and explain sampling.

li: security checklist: (a) ensure tenant_id is never in public metrics or logs, (b) console queries must be tenant-scoped server-side (no client-side tenant_id exposure), (c) internal clickhouse access requires VPN + audit trail.

sam: implementation detail: runtime will add header `X-Redwood-Tenant` in internal traces and push to our ingestion pipeline. example log line we will emit:```
{"ts":"...","tenant_id":"org_123","route":"/v1/generate","latency_ms":120,"queue_time_ms":10,"tokens_out":42}
```
we'll also emit an aggregated metric: `redwood_infer_tokens_total{tenant_bucket="b123",model="rw-13b"}`

marie: li — can you confirm storage retention for detailed per-tenant logs? product wants 30 days for pilot.

li: 30 days is fine for internal cluster with cold storage. cost estimate: ~0.7TB per month at current pilot volume. will queue a ticket for capacity.

nika: one more for rollout UX: customers should be able to opt into more detailed billing telemetry (higher cardinality) for an extra fee. i.e., opt-in dimension. we need consent flow + billing flag.

marie: noted. action items: (1) sam to add tenant_bucket + queue_time_ms + emit example log by EOW (2) li to create storage ticket + RBAC plan by Tue (3) product to draft console wireframe for per-org page (nika) by next Thurs.

sam: starting a small PR branch now: `feat/tenant-metrics` — will post link when ready.

telemetry-bot: new metric detected: redwood_infer_latency_p95 - instrumented by runtime. auto-comment: consider adding tenant_bucket label for console use.

marie: thanks. also we need a noisy-neighbor rule: detect orgs where `cpu_util_delta > 20%` and `latency_p95 > baseline + 50ms` for a sustained 2m window. alert should create CS ticket + open SRE pager if severity high.

li: will prototype alert playbook. question: do we want automatic mitigation (throttle/burst isolation) or just alerting?

sam: runtime can do soft limits per tenant (rate limit tokens/s) as a fallback. prefer alerting first for pilot, then evaluate auto-throttle in stage.

nika: for the console, show a subtle banner when we detect noisy neighbor events with link to explain why and steps (contact CS, request dedicated capacity). keep wording friendly.

marie: perfect. last thing — telemetry queries must avoid exploding cost for console customers. set hard query timeouts (10s) and max series scanned. add caching for 1m windows.

sam: will add `X-Telemetry-Query-Limit` enforcement to the telemetry API.

li: ACK. i'll draft RBAC + audit doc and ping legal about PII clause.

marie: thanks everyone. i'll open a tracking ticket with the action items and link this thread. meeting if needed: Thu 10am to align on alert thresholds. :calendar:

nika: :raised_hands:

sam: :shipit:
